main_claim: Dana White hinted that Ilia Topuria's next fight may be against Paddy Pimblett, and fans online reacted unhappily to the idea of a non-title headliner.
note: The news is 'Dana White ... hinted that the El Matador might face Paddy Pimblett next', so the source is the promotion, the act a factual update on his plans, and the fact a next-fight rumour with substance (who said it) though 'no set date for Topuria's return has been announced'; the fan tweets dominate the text (source could be fans), a hint could be read as a forecast rather than a plain statement (act none_of_these), Pimblett could be read as an option only (fact status_update), and the promotion's own hint could be read as reported rather than rumour. His 'confirmed return' is only described, not quoted, so he_speaks is no; the Gaethje injuries and loss are background.
